In the endpoint localized quotient MC_3,4/im(d4), unique intermediate-line square generators and collinear chains yield integral unit-pivot eliminations; the remaining differential onto MC_2,4 has independent integral unit pivots. Its kernel is freely generated by q² combinations A_R+C_R-u_(PR)-v_(RQ), identified with the displayed z classes. This proves all-field/ all-finite-projective-plane integral freeness without a Desarguesian assumption. Point-line duality and incidence automorphisms permute labels without signs. Automorphism group of incidence graph has order 336 and is sharply transitive on 336 labels of ordered noncollinear/nonconcurrent triples, giving integral regular representation.
